#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <regex>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    string input;
    getline(cin, input);
    int n = stoi(input);
    
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    s = regex_replace(s, regex("_+"), " ");
    
    stringstream spaced;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == '(') {
            spaced << " ( ";
        } else if (c == ')') {
            spaced << " ) ";
        } else {
            spaced << c;
        }
    }
    
    regex word_regex("\\S+");
    smatch match;
    string spaced_str = spaced.str();
    sregex_iterator iter(spaced_str.begin(), spaced_str.end(), word_regex);
    sregex_iterator end;
    
    bool inside = false;
    int max_len = 0;
    int count = 0;
    
    while (iter != end) {
        string token = iter->str();
        if (token.find('(') != string::npos && token.find(')') == string::npos) {
            inside = true;
        } else if (token.find(')') != string::npos) {
            inside = false;
        } else if (token.find('(') == string::npos && token.find(')') == string::npos) {
            if (inside) {
                count++;
            } else {
                max_len = max(max_len, (int)token.length());
            }
        }
        ++iter;
    }
    
    cout << max_len << " " << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
